_comment: Curated fixed schedules expanded into concrete events by scripts/ingest.ts (next ~7 weeks). Use these for reliable programs on bot-protected sites (store kids' workshops) and known weekly series (farmers markets, summer concerts). schedule.day: 0=Sunday..6=Saturday; time is Pacific; ordinals apply to freq=monthly; months restricts seasonal series. Verify seasonal date ranges each year.

events.title: Free Crafts for Kids at Lakeshore Learning
events.desc: Drop-in craft table every Saturday, 11am-3pm. Ages 3+, no registration needed — a new themed craft each week.

events.title: Home Depot Kids Workshop (Concord)
events.desc: Free hands-on build workshop the first Saturday of each month, 9am-12pm while supplies last. Kit, apron, pin and certificate included. Register online.

events.title: Lowe's Kids Workshop (Concord)
events.desc: Free monthly kids' build workshop (typically third Saturday, 10am sessions). Ages 4-11. Registration required via MyLowe's Rewards.

events.title: Michaels Sunday MAKEbreak (Pleasant Hill)
events.desc: Free in-store family craft session, typically first and third Sundays 2-4pm. Check the store's events page for this month's project.

events.title: Saturday Storytime at Barnes & Noble
events.desc: Weekly storytime at the Plaza Escuela store, Saturdays at 11am.

events.title: Walnut Creek Farmers Market
events.desc: Year-round Sunday farmers market, 9am-1pm — produce, food stands and stroller-friendly wandering.

events.title: Concord Farmers Market at Todos Santos Plaza
events.desc: Year-round Tuesday farmers market, 9am-2pm, on the plaza playground's doorstep.

events.title: Danville Farmers Market
events.desc: Year-round Saturday farmers market at 205 Railroad Ave.

events.title: Martinez Farmers Market
events.desc: Year-round Sunday farmers market at Main St & Estudillo St.

events.title: Pleasant Hill Farmers Market
events.desc: Seasonal Saturday farmers market at City Hall, 9am-1pm (May-November).

events.title: Concord Music & Market
events.desc: Free Thursday-evening concerts on the plaza, 6:30-8pm (June-September), with the farmers market from 4pm. Bring a blanket — very kid-friendly.

events.title: Pleasant Hill Off the Grid Food Trucks
events.desc: Food trucks, live music and lawn games every Thursday 5-9pm (April-October). Free entry.

events.title: Moraga Summer Concerts at the Commons
events.desc: Free Thursday-evening concerts at the Commons bandshell, 6:30-8:30pm (July-August), next to the playground and spray park.

events.title: Orinda Summer Concerts in the Park
events.desc: Free Thursday concerts in the park, 6-8pm (June-August).

events.title: San Ramon Summer Concerts at Central Park
events.desc: Free Sunday-evening concerts at the Central Park amphitheater, 5:30pm (June-August), with food trucks.

events.title: Alamo Summer Concerts at Livorna Park
events.desc: Free Friday-evening concerts at Livorna Park, 6:30-8:30pm (July), with food trucks.
